mapper.select: SELECT ci.id, ci.serial_number AS serialNumber, ci.status, ci.issue_date AS issueDate, ci.expire_date AS expireDate, ci.validity_label AS validityLabel, ci.blockchain_hash AS blockchainHash, ct.id AS templateId, ct.title AS templateTitle, ct.level_label AS levelLabel, ct.category, ct.issue_org AS issueOrg, ct.validity_months AS validityMonths, ct.description, ct.privilege_text AS privilegeText, u.name AS userName, u.employee_no AS employeeNo, d.name AS department FROM certificate_issue ci JOIN certificate_template ct ON ct.id = ci.template_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ci.user_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = u.department_id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} AND ci.status = 2 AND ci.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ci.issue_date DESC, ci.id DESC

SELECT ci.id, ci.serial_number AS serialNumber, ci.status, ci.issue_date AS issueDate, ci.expire_date AS expireDate, ci.validity_label AS validityLabel, ci.blockchain_hash AS blockchainHash, ct.title AS templateTitle, ct.level_label AS levelLabel, ct.category, ct.issue_org AS issueOrg, ct.validity_months AS validityMonths, ct.privilege_text AS privilegeText, u.name AS userName, u.employee_no AS employeeNo, d.name AS department FROM certificate_issue ci JOIN certificate_template ct ON ct.id = ci.template_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ci.user_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = u.department_id WHERE ci.serial_number = #{serial} AND ci.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
